body:
Erik,
	Thanks so much for finding that.
 Do we know the screen name of the person who recommended its creation, rather
than just the individual who approved it?  Can you retrieve any discussion
about its creation?  Relatedly, if someone wanted it created, it would be odd
if that  person did not then post after it was created -- that is, why was the
first post apparently not until seven months later?

Although I'm sure it's not related,
there's a George Mason student who wrote a neat comparison between the Zen and
the Art of Motorcycle Maintenance and the manifesto.

____________
FIRST THREAD -
"we?"
From:       72103.604@compuserve.com (Dan May)
Date:         1996/01/04

In reading the manifesto I see many references to "FC" as in: "But we
(FC) don't think it is inevitable.  We think it can be stopped, and we
will give here some indications of how to go about stopping it." What
group do the letters FC refer to and while we're at it, who coined the
name unabomber, and why?

DM
